bullets: Business Incubation & Startup Growth: Actively contributed to the Technology Business Incubator (IBT) program, conducting commercial potential mapping, Business Model Canvas (BMC) validation, and strategic scale-up planning for incubated startup tenants.
Entrepreneurship Training & Digital Marketing: Facilitated digital marketing, e-commerce adoption, and brand storytelling workshops for MSMEs and incubator cohort entrepreneurs.
Content Strategy & Program Publication: Designed thematic social media content calendars and managed campaign performance tracking to elevate ecosystem engagement and program visibility.
Operations & Ecosystem Coordination: Coordinated day-to-day incubator operations, workshop facilitation, and structured documentation for technology incubation milestone reviews.
Assist the Chairman in managing organizational operations and strategic planning.
Coordinate communication and collaboration across organizational divisions.
Supervise the implementation of high-impact technology & research programs.
Supported the rollout of Web 3 innovation hackathons and technology competition programs.
Assisted participant onboarding and coordinated operational events.
Spearheaded promotional campaigns across developer communities.
Designed and delivered engaging digital literacy and educational programs for Indonesian students in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Collaborated with international youth delegates in cultural exchange and leadership development.
